title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Analista de Requisitos/Negócios SR
description:
Papel estratégico na ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, responsável por construir a visão e o roadmap da solução, maximizar o valor entregue e garantir um backlog claro, priorizado e continuamente refinado em um contexto ágil.


Atividades principais:

  • Definir e comunicar a visão e o roadmap da solução, alinhando objetivos de negócio e métricas de sucesso.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios na priorização de entregas de maior valor, com base em dados e técnicas de priorização.
  • Manter o backlog claro, organizado e continuamente refinado (histórias, critérios de aceite, dependências).
  • Conduzir discovery e elicitação de requisitos com stakeholders, transformando necessidades em especificações acionáveis.


Requisitos:

title: Inside Sales (Vendedor Interno)
description:
Prazer, somos a Tripla.


Uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia que protege e impulsiona negócios — esse é o nosso propósito. Atuamos nacionalmente com soluções especializadas em infraestrutura, cibersegurança, continuidade de negócios e governança & compliance.


Trabalhamos para remover as barreiras tecnológicas que impedem o crescimento sustentável das empresas.


Com nossas soluções, ajudamos a manter a operação disponível, protegida e em conformidade — permitindo que você economize recursos e tenha mais tempo para investir na estratégia do seu negócio.


Com mais de 500 organizações atendidas e parcerias com os principais players do mercado, cocriamos um futuro mais eficiente, resiliente e escalável para nossos clientes.


E o nosso diferencial? Acreditamos que pessoas incríveis constroem resultados incríveis. Aqui, cada Tripulante é parte essencial da nossa jornada!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Vendedor Interno para atuar com vendas em soluções de Tecnologia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Buscamos um profissional que será responsável por atender leads de base e novos, qualificando e apresentando soluções tecnológicas de forma consultiva e conduzindo todo o ciclo de vendas de maneira remota. Atuar na geração de novos negócios e na construção de um relacionamento sólido com os clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da empresa e o atingimento das metas comerciais.


1. Identificar e conduzir oportunidades de vendas na área de tecnologia da informação por meio de abordagens remotas visando a geração de novos negócios e o alcance das metas de vendas da empresa.

2. Qualificar leads para garantir que atendam aos critérios de encaixe com as soluções da empresa.

3. Estabelecer contato inicial com prospects e clientes potenciais, visando a busca de novas oportunidades de negócio.

4. Realizar apresentações de produtos e serviços de tecnologia aos clientes visando geração de novos negócios para a empresa.

5. Identificar e entender as necessidades dos clientes visando propor soluções e projetos personalizados e inovadores para o atendimento de suas demandas de forma assertiva visando a continuidade ou criação de novas oportunidades de negócios.

6. Colaborar com a equipe técnica sempre que demandado auxiliando no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para os clientes da carteira sob sua responsabilidade visando o atendimento de demandas identificadas.

7. Manter registros precisos das interações com os clientes no sistema de gerenciamento de vendas. Visando o controle efetivo das oportunidades de vendas prospectadas.


8. Buscar manter-se atualizado sobre produtos e serviços de tecnologia para melhor atender aos clientes, bem como sobre as tendências do setor, concorrência e melhores práticas de abordagens vendas remotas, visando geração de novos negócios.

9. Construir e manter relacionamentos com os clientes da carteira sob sua responsabilidade visando a continuidade e/ou a possibilidades de novos negócios.


Requisitos e qualificações:


-Conhecimento básico em produtos e serviços de TI.

-Experiência em vendas consultivas, preferencialmente em tecnologia da informação.

- Capacidade de ouvir atentamente e entender as necessidades dos clientes.

- Capacidade de análise.

- Ter conhecimento na aplicabilidade de metodologias de vendas - Spin Selling e BANT.

- Usar ferramenta de gestão de clientes CRM.


Informações adicionais:


  • Ajuda de custo de R$40,10 por dia útil.
  • Plano de saúde unimed (Unipart) 90% da mensalidade é custeada pela empresa e 10% pelo colaborador + a coparticipação.
  • Unimed odonto 100% custeado pela Tripla.
  • Gympass.
  • Allya.
  • Incentivo a Capacitação em curso e certificação.
  • Day off no aniversário.
  • PPR.
  • VT ou Auxílio Mobilidade.

description:

We’re a fast-growing SaaS company, leading the market and scaling fast — and we’re looking for a seasoned Full Stack engineer to join our high-performance team and build impactful features across our product suite.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) (Exclusiva para Pessoa com Deficiência)
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Software Engineer Mid Level para integrar o Billing Team no Brasil.


Este time é responsável por toda a plataforma que processa vendas, renovações de assinaturas e fluxos de receita, criando registros de recebíveis de clientes, além de gerenciar processos de cobrança (dunning).

Trabalhar em conjunto com um time de ~9 engenheiros(as) mid/sênior, implementando, testando e entregando soluções;

Formação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente;

Experiência em engenharia de software, com histórico de entregas de qualidade;

Experiência em Java/Kotlin + Spring (RESTful APIs);

Conhecimentos em SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB);

Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e entendimento de escalabilidade;

Interesse em aprender mais sobre arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e Serverless;

Conhecimento em Cloud Computing (AWS) e Cloud Native (Kubernetes);

Inglês intermediário (essencial para documentação, comentários e comunicação interna), com abertura para evoluir

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Back end- Java+ AWS
description:
Código da vaga: 55269


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor Back end venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência comprovada com Java (Spring Boot).

Experiência em AWS, especialmente Glue, CloudFormation, Lambdas e serviços de computação e dados.

Familiaridade com práticas de versionamento e integração contínua.

Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas técnicos.

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análise de fontes e identificação de melhorias em sistemas existentes.
  • Migrar jobs do Glue e realizar ajustes em pipelines de dados.
  • Investigar e corrigir bugs em aplicações backend.
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Java e serviços da AWS.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como AWS CloudFormation para provisionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Colaborar com times técnicos em ambientes ágeis.




Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – AI

Contract: 6–12 months (extendable)

Location: Remote – Nearshore (EST hours preferred)


Overview

Our client is looking for a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer – AI to join the engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building full-stack applications (80% backend / 20% frontend) , with solid expertise in Go, Python, or Node.js on the backend and Angular on the frontend.


This professional will contribute to the development of AI-powered tools and applications , supporting initiatives involving Generative AI . While deep AI expertise is not required, prior experience integrating or using AI tools is highly desirable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI platforms and AI-powered applications.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI technologies and explore opportunities for integration.
  • Build, enhance, and maintain scalable web applications with a focus on performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and SRE.
  • Implement best practices for security, scalability, and software delivery.
  • Contribute to CI/CD processes to ensure smooth and consistent releases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote technical excellence within the team.


Requirements

Must-Have Skills:

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong backend experience with Go (preferred) , Python , or Node.js .
  • Frontend experience with Angular (or a similar modern framework).
  • Experience with Azure and API development .
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL (approximately 10–15% of responsibilities).
  • Practical experience with AI tools (e.g., Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines , Docker , and GitHub .
  • Experience working in distributed teams using Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Asana .


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Terraform (preferred but not required).
  • Exposure to TypeScript and React .
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Previous background in education, finance, or healthcare industries.


Preferred Profile

  • 80% backend (Go, Python, Node.js) and 20% frontend (Angular).
  • Hands-on experience with AI integration or experimentation .
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills in distributed environments.
  • Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and accountability.

  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!

If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Sales Intern (Adtech - US Visa Sponsored)
description:

About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are seeking a versatile and experienced (Job Title) to lead our (scope). This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced global environment and can (expectation).

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Golang)

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Experience: 8+ years overall

Engagement: Contractor

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Golang , Node.js , and React to develop and enhance high-performance, scalable backend services. The role emphasizes Go, gRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development across AWS and GCP . You will be responsible for building robust backend services, integrating with MongoDB , streaming data via Kafka , and ensuring reliability in containerized environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain data-intensive Go and Node.js gRPC APIs.
  • Build, containerize, and deploy scalable Go microservices on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE).
  • Refactor and modernize legacy Node.js services into idiomatic Go for improved performance and stability.
  • Integrate and operate Apache Kafka pipelines for high-throughput event streaming.
  • Leverage AWS and GCP cloud services to build resilient, cost-effective solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Conduct code reviews , mentor junior engineers, and promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security.
  • Participate in architectural design reviews , focusing on scalability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Program Management, and QA.
  • Provide realistic level of effort (LOE) estimates during planning cycles.
  • Prototype and experiment with emerging technologies to improve engineering velocity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade, highly scalable Go services.
  • Expertise in writing high-performance gRPC and REST clients/servers, including protobuf contracts.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (stream processing, topic management, schema registry, ACLs, consumers, offsets).
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS (S3, CloudFront, EKS, etc.).
  • 1+ year of experience with GCP (Cloud Storage, Kafka, GKE, CDN, etc.).
  • 2+ years of experience designing and using MongoDB .

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years developing full-stack applications using Node.js , MongoDB , Express , and React .
  • 3+ years of experience with EKS/GKE , Helm , Terraform , and CI/CD pipelines .
  • 1+ year of Linux bash scripting for automation and ops tasks.
  • Exposure to Redis , Docker , Git , and observability stacks (Prometheus , Grafana , OpenTelemetry ).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills in a globally distributed team.
  • Experience with MongoDB schemas , indexing, and sharding strategies.
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and CRUD operations .

Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect with 15+ years of hands-on experience in architecting, designing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be a Java ecosystem expert (Java 17+, Spring Boot 3) with a strong background in microservices architecture , event-driven design , and cloud-native development . Additionally, the candidate should have practical experience with Angular 15+ , enabling seamless integration between backend services and modern frontend applications.


You will lead the end-to-end architecture for mission-critical systems, driving innovation , scalability , and security across multi-cloud environments (AWS primary, with exposure to GCP/Azure), while ensuring cohesive full-stack design and implementation.


Key Responsibilities


Architectural Ownership – Define, design, and govern technical architecture for enterprise-grade, Java-centric applications and microservices.

Microservices & Distributed Systems – Architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems leveraging Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, and Reactive frameworks.

Cloud Architecture – Design cloud-native solutions leveraging AWS core services (ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.), with working knowledge of GCP/Azure equivalents.

Event-Driven and Data Architecture – Build streaming and asynchronous data pipelines using Kafka, Spark, or other event-driven frameworks.

Containerization & DevOps Integration – Define strategies for container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD).

Security and Identity Management – Implement enterprise-grade security patterns using Okta, Keycloak, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect; enforce API gateway and token-based authentication standards.

Polyglot Architecture – Provide architectural guidance for cross-technology integrations, including Node.js, Python, and other service layers where applicable.

FE Architecture - Architect and implement scalable frontend applications that integrate seamlessly with backend microservices, ensuring performance optimization, enforcing reusable component standards, and collaboration cross teams to align Angular frontend and backend architecture within a secure, cloud-native environment.

AI Experience – Hands on experience implementing applications using code assistant tools like GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude.ai, etc.

Technical Leadership – Act as a hands-on thought leader and mentor for development teams, conducting design reviews, performance optimization sessions, and code-level guidance.

Best Practices & Governance – Establish coding standards, reusable frameworks, and architecture blueprints to ensure maintainability and long-term scalability.

Stakeholder Collaboration – Partner closely with product owners, business analysts, and DevOps teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.


Required Skills & Experience


Core Expertise:

  • Java 17+, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, RESTful API design
  • Angular 15+
  • Atlas MongoDB
  • AI code generation
  • Microservices architecture and domain-driven design (DDD)
  • Messaging and streaming platforms (Kafka, Spark)
  • Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Cloud platforms (AWS mandatory; GCP/Azure good to have)

Security:

  • Authentication & Authorization using Okta, Keycloak, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT


DevOps & Observability:

  • CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), logging, and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch)


Database Experience:

  • Both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), ElasticSearch


AI Experience:

  • Practical Experience using AI-powered development tools such as: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude.ai, etc.
  • Implementation experience of AI Integration Use Cases Accelerating code generation and refactoring
  • Enhancing productivity in architectural prototyping
  • Supporting documentation and test case generation
  • Leveraging AI for performance tuning and design suggestions


Angular experience:

  • Experience implementing Modular frontend applications; strong grasp of component architecture, performance optimization and secure API integration.


Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities (Must be fluent in English).
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor cross-functional teams


Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills



  • Exposure to API Gateway / Service Mesh (Istio, Kong, or AWS API Gateway)
  • Experience with Reactive programming (WebFlux, Project Reactor)
  • Knowledge of Data Lakes, Data Warehousing


How They Work

  • Contract Type : This is a 1-year contract opportunity with a strong possibility of extension based on performance and evolving business needs.
  • Work Culture : They foster a collaborative and respectful environment that values work-life balance and autonomy.
  • Professional Development : They support continuous learning through access to training resources, mentorship, and growth opportunities.
  • Remote-First Setup : They operate remotely, with a preference for candidates who can maintain overlap with Eastern Time (EST) from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM for effective collaboration.
  • Inclusive Environment : This Client is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we welcome professionals from all backgrounds.
  • Role Evolution : As their business grows, your responsibilities may evolve—offering the chance to expand your impact and skill set.

  • 30 minutes screening with Recruiter and form fulfilling – Nov/10 to Nov/14
  • First Round Screening Interviews 90-minute interviews to assess Java, Angular, MongoDB, AI experience, Cultural fit. Timeline: Nov 17-28
  • Second Round Deep Technical Interviews Conduct 60-minute interviews focused on architecture, MongoDB transformation, and AI integration. Timeline: Dec 1-12

title: Compliance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and test the company’s internal controls system, ensuring alignment with Brazilian laws and global compliance standards.
  • Oversee the regulatory compliance framework, including corporate policies, compliance testing, and audit readiness.
  • Manage the Asset Segregation framework according to Central Bank of Brazil's and other related regulations, including including policies, record segregation, reconciliations, audit trails, and proof-of-reserves (where applicable).
  • Establish and maintain effective transfer and custody controls for client and company assets.
  • Coordinate internal reviews and remediation actions based on control testing outcomes or regulatory findings.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of mandatory compliance policies, including third-party risk and service provider management (excluding “Essential Services,” which remain under AML/CFT oversight).
  • Liaise with auditors, regulators, and internal governance bodies on matters relating to controls, segregation, and compliance.
  • Support a strong compliance culture by promoting accountability, transparency, and ethical conduct across teams.

Requireme nts:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in internal controls, compliance, or risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated operational independence and familiarity with control frameworks under the Central Bank of Brazil, COAF, and CVM.
  • Proven understanding of asset segregation, audit principles, and compliance testing methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Accounting, Finance, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills; fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Desenvolvedor Sr de Integrações SAP CPI (PJ | Remoto)
description:

Profissional especializado no desenvolvimento de soluções de integração, combinando APIs síncronas e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para conectar sistemas de maneira eficiente, segura e escalável. Possui sólida experiência em SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) e Kafka , garantindo integrações robustas entre ERP SAP S/4 e sistemas distribuídos.


Atua no design e implementação de APIs REST, SOAP e OData , bem como em event streaming e pub/sub , permitindo comunicação em tempo real entre aplicações. Trabalha com práticas de DevOps, observabilidade e segurança , visando otimizar performance, resiliência e governança das integrações.

• Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e integração de sistemas corporativos .

• Conhecimento avançado em padrões de design de APIs (REST, SOAP, OData, OpenAPI) e event-driven architecture .

• APIs: REST, SOAP, OData, OpenAPI/Swagger.

• Segurança: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT.

• Event Streaming: Confluent Cloud (Kafka), Kafka Streams, KSQL, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink.

• Testes de Integração: Postman, SoapUI, Mountebank, Pact.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON: ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.

title: Data Engineer - Databricks
description:

  • Rebuild Data Quality scorecards in Databricks
  • Develop profiling logic (nulls, distincts, pattern checks)
  • Build PySpark-based Data Quality rules and row/column-level metrics
  • Create curated DQ datasets for Power BI scorecards
  • Establish reusable DQ rule templates and standardized development patterns
  • Work with SAP ECC data models
  • Support and mentor a junior developer (Mexico-based) on rule logic and development standards


Qualifications

  • Strong Databricks engineering experience (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake)
  • Hands-on experience building Data Quality rules, frameworks, or scorecards
  • Experience in profiling large datasets and implementing metadata-driven DQ logic
  • Ability to mentor, review code, and explain concepts clearly
  • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Familiarity with SAP ECC tables and key fields (preferred)
  • Experience with Unity Catalog or Purview (nice to have)
  • Exposure to Lakehouse Monitoring or DQX accelerators (bonus)


If you are passionate about Data Quality, strong in Databricks/PySpark, and enjoy building reusable DQ capabilities, please apply today for immediate consideration!

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Possuir graduação de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou qualquer curso superior acompanhado de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) em TI, com carga horária mínima de 360 horas;
  • Ter experiência comprovada como profissional na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Possuir certificação obrigatória OutSystems Security Specialization Exam .


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Conhecimento em práticas ágeis, incluindo design incremental, design thinking, planning poker, refactoring, testes automatizados, BDD (Behavior-Driven Development), TDD (Test-Driven Development), DevOps, programação em par, inspeção e revisão de código, definição de preparado (DOR) e de pronto (DOD), integração e entrega contínua, propriedade coletiva do código, histórias de usuário, critérios de aceitação, linguagem Gherkin, PDCA, produtização, IaC (Infrastructure as Code) e CaC (Configuration as Code);
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e metodologias como Manifesto Ágil, SCRUM, KANBAN, Lean, XP, DevOps, SAFe®, SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), ITIL, COBIT, AIOps, FinOps, CMMI, MPS.BR e SOx;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem Azure e AWS ;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderar os times de Sistema e Desenvolvimento, promovendo o desenvolvimento seguro de aplicações e disseminando as melhores práticas de DevSecOps;
  • Conscientizar os times sobre a importância da segurança no desenvolvimento e fomentar a adoção de práticas de DevSecOps;
  • Garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento seguro, incluindo análise de segurança, portões de segurança (security gates) no pipeline DevSecOps e correção de vulnerabilidades;
  • Operar e apoiar o uso de ferramentas de segurança DAST, como Acunetix, e outras adotadas no pipeline DevSecOps;
  • Operar e apoiar o uso da ferramenta AI Mentor;
  • Acompanhar o nível de segurança das aplicações, monitorando vulnerabilidades e suas respectivas correções;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar planos de ação para correção de vulnerabilidades, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos pelos times;
  • Atuar como interlocutor e representante da área de Segurança da Informação (SI) do cliente, promovendo programas de conscientização e práticas de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Exercer o papel de Security Champion da SI do cliente, sendo o ponto focal para correção de vulnerabilidades e solução de problemas de segurança no pipeline DevSecOps;
  • Criar e divulgar conteúdos e materiais educativos sobre princípios e práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e DevSecOps;
  • Conduzir apresentações, workshops e outras ações de capacitação para aumentar a conscientização sobre segurança no desenvolvimento e nas operações de TIC;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações em segurança da informação, alinhando as práticas internas aos padrões de mercado e às diretrizes do cliente;
  • Colaborar com a SI na formação de Champions OutSystems voltados ao desenvolvimento seguro e DevSecOps;
  • Implementar mecanismos de melhoria contínua para capacitar os Champions OutSystems em práticas seguras de desenvolvimento e DevSecOps;
  • Acompanhar e orientar os Champions OutSystems, oferecendo suporte e recursos para disseminação de boas práticas;

title: SAP PPDS Consultant
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SAP PPDS Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PPDS/ePPDS) , preferably in an S/4HANA environment . This role involves working closely with business stakeholders to design, configure, and implement advanced planning solutions that optimize manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and support of SAP PPDS solutions in S/4HANA environments.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to gather requirements and provide the best SAP-based planning and scheduling solutions.
  • Configure PPDS functionalities such as heuristic-based planning, optimizer-based planning, block planning, and capacity leveling.
  • Optimize master data such as resource capacities, production versions, PDS (Production Data Structures), and PPMs (Production Process Models) .
  • Integrate PPDS with other SAP modules like PP, MM, SD, and EWM for seamless production planning.
  • Provide expertise in Order-based and Time-continuous Scheduling , pegging strategies, and alert monitoring.
  • Support CIF (Core Interface) integration between SAP ERP and PPDS.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring smooth business operations.
  • Conduct user training and create documentation for system configurations and processes.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in SAP PPDS implementation and support.
  • Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA PPDS , including DS Board, PPDS Optimizer, Planning Procedures, and Interactive Planning .
  • Experience in CIF integration between SAP ECC/S4HANA and PPDS.
  • Solid understanding of production planning processes , including Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock (MTS), and Repetitive Manufacturing .
  • Hands-on experience in heuristics, capacity leveling, and scheduling strategies .
  • Strong knowledge of SAP PP/MM and integration with EWM .
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP PPDS certification .
  • Experience with Industry-specific solutions such as Automotive, Consumer Goods, or Manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) and APO (Advanced Planning & Optimization).

O(A) profissional será responsável pela gestão completa (P&L, KPIs e estratégia) de duas frentes de alta volumetria: Marketplaces tradicionais e Parcerias de Loyalty.

Este papel exige um perfil comercial e analítico para maximizar o faturamento, gerir a margem, liderar negociações complexas com grandes parceiros e garantir a execução das campanhas em alinhamento com stakeholders internos (Comercial, Jurídico, Operações).


Responsabilidades


  • Gestão Estratégica e P&L: Definir e executar a estratégia comercial dos canais "Out", gerenciando o P&L completo (GMV, Receita, Margem, ROAS) e a estratégia de precificação para garantir a rentabilidade.

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas, desdobrando metas estratégicas em KPIs acionáveis e garantindo a execução de alta performance.
  • Análise e Performance: Gerir os KPIs estratégicos dos canais, analisando dados (data-driven) para direcionar decisões e reportar a performance para a gestão executiva.
  • Gestão Operacional (Oversight): Supervisionar as operações da equipe, incluindo performance de mídia (ADS), gestão de onsite (ex: Lojas Oficiais), integrações (hubs), cadastro de produtos e interfaces com áreas de suporte (Expedição, Atendimento, Financeiro).
  • Contratos e Compliance: Conduzir a análise e validação de contratos comerciais com todos os parceiros, em interface direta com o time Jurídico e Comercial.


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de Marketplaces e/ou gestão de parcerias de Loyalty.
  • Domínio em análise e gestão de P&L de canal, com foco em margem e precificação.
  • Forte habilidade de negociação comercial e análise de contratos.
  • Experiência em gestão de mídia paga (ADS) dentro dos ecossistemas de marketplace.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada (Excel mandatório; Power BI/Looker desejável).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de hub de integração (ex: Anymarket, Hubsales) e plataformas de E-commerce (ex: ATG).
  • Foco em Resultado e Rentabilidade: Entender que vender com margem é o objetivo principal.
  • Habilidade de Negociação e Influência: Articulação para negociar com parceiros externos e influenciar stakeholders internos (Jurídico, Comercial).
  • Visão Analítica (Data-Driven): Capacidade de mergulhar nos números para tomar decisões.
  • Senso de Dono (Ownership): Tratar os canais parceiros como sua própria unidade de negócio.
  • Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Lidar com alta volumetria e múltiplos parceiros simultaneamente.
  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: Capacidade de treinar, mentorar e gerir a equipe de analistas (performance e operações).

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


1. Backend & API Development

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com FastAPI (Python).
  • Integrar serviços de backend com Snowflake e Databricks, consumindo datasets curados e expondo-os via APIs seguras.
  • Escrever SQL de forma eficiente para extração e transformação de dados (experiência apenas com ORM não atende).
  • Implementar autenticação via JWT e RBAC para garantir segurança dos endpoints.
  • Trabalhar com times de frontend e produto para definir modelos, esquemas e endpoints.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, confiabilidade e alta performance no backend.


2. Frontend Development

  • Criar interfaces responsivas e sustentáveis com React + TypeScript.
  • Consumir APIs e garantir precisão e performance na renderização dos dados no UI.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o backend para manter consistência no fluxo de dados.
  • Melhorar continuamente legibilidade, manutenção e experiência do usuário.


3. CI/CD & Cloud Deployment

  • Utilizar GitHub e GitHub Actions para CI/CD.
  • Automatizar pipelines de build, teste e deploy, mantendo padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Fazer deploy em Azure Cloud, garantindo consistência entre Test, UAT e Production.


4. Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Criar testes automatizados com Pytest e garantir execução no pipeline de CI.
  • Participar de peer reviews para prevenir regressões e fortalecer qualidade do código.



O que você precisa ter


  • Inglês avançado para comunicação;
  • Python;
  • FastAPI;
  • React;

Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

description:

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).


About the Role


We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
