  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.


Requirements:


  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .


Nice to Have


  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Na VMetrix, não oferecemos apenas um emprego, mas uma oportunidade de transformar o futuro do setor financeiro. Você fará parte de uma empresa que lidera com inovação, redefinindo padrões com soluções SaaS de classe mundial. Aqui valorizamos o aprendizado contínuo, a colaboração e a autenticidade.

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:

About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. • Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

title: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager
description:
About Dacxi Chain


Dacxi Chain is building the critical infrastructure for the future of global capital formation. As the world's first tokenized crowdfunding infrastructure, we're creating the foundational layer that enables entrepreneurs to connect with everyday investors worldwide through blockchain technology. By tokenizing company shares on our infrastructure, we're eliminating traditional barriers like geographical borders and limited liquidity - making capital raising seamless for businesses and investment opportunities accessible to everyone, everywhere. We're not just creating a platform; we're architecting the essential infrastructure that will power the next generation of crowdfunding - transparent, scalable, and globally accessible.



Job Description: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager


We are searching for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager to lead our most critical initiatives. This advanced hybrid role combines the governance of a PMO, the hands-on coordination of a Delivery Manager, and the technical depth of a Project Manager. You will also be entrusted with key Product Owner responsibilities, acting as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure projects are not only delivered on time and within budget but also align with our strategic product vision and maintain the highest quality standards.

Important: This role is only open to candidates based in Brazil , and requires fluent Portuguese and fluent English .


This is a fully remote position, working with teams across Brazil, the UK, and New Zealand.


Key Responsibilities:


Project Governance & Technical PMO:

  • Develop, refine, and enforce technical project management methodologies and best practices across the organization.
  • Manage and maintain a comprehensive RAID log, proactively identifying and mitigating potential roadblocks.
  • Maintain a decision log to document and track key project decisions, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Oversee an action log, holding all team members and stakeholders accountable for their commitments.
  • Implement "Planned vs. Actual" reporting to track project performance against initial baselines, highlighting deviations in scope, schedule, and budget.

Delivery & Release Management:

  • Serve as the central point of contact for project coordination, facilitating communication and collaboration between product, development, QA, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams across different time zones.
  • Partner with QA to ensure testing is integrated seamlessly into the project lifecycle, from early-stage validation to final quality assurance.
  • Coordinate with GTM teams to align on release schedules and ensure a smooth, well-prepared launch of new products or features.
  • Orchestrate and manage the end-to-end release process, ensuring all dependencies are met and risks are mitigated.
  • Hold product and engineering teams accountable for their commitments, ensuring deliverables are met on time and to the required standard.

Project & Product Ownership:

  • Lead the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to execution and post-mortem analysis.
  • Act as the Product Owner for specific initiatives, ensuring the development team's work aligns with the overall product roadmap.
  • Translate business and user needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
  • Proactively identify and address potential pitfalls, technical debt, and risks to ensure the project stays on track.
  • Provide high-quality, data-driven reporting to leadership and stakeholders, offering transparent insights into project status and performance.


Qualifications:


  • Proven experience in a technical project management role, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated experience with PMO functions, including process standardization, governance, and portfolio management.
  • Must be currently based in Brazil and fluent in both written and verbal Portuguese and English.
  • Expertise in managing project documentation, specifically RAID logs, decision logs, and action logs.
  • A track record of successfully holding cross-functional teams accountable for their deliverables.
  • Experience performing Product Owner duties, such as managing a product backlog and defining user stories.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of coordinating development, QA, and GTM teams across global locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights from metrics like "planned vs. actual".
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or similar) are highly desirable.


Preferred Skills:


  • Innovative Mindset: A forward-thinking approach, staying ahead of industry and technology trends.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven decision-making approach.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to manage expectations and keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned.
  • Execution & Ownership: Strong sense of ownership, with a track record of driving complex projects to completion on time and to quality.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adjusting plans as priorities evolve.


This role is for a proactive leader who is passionate about both the big picture and the details. If you're ready to define processes, drive technical delivery, hold teams accountable, and help shape our product vision, we want to hear from you.


Interested?


If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! Join us in revolutionizing the global funding landscape at Dacxi Chain.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing
description:
Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Visão Geral da Posição

O Consultor de Ativação de Marketing é responsável por configurar e executar campanhas de CRM e Loyalty no Salesforce Marketing Cloud , transformando estratégias de jornada em ações concretas por meio do uso avançado das funcionalidades da plataforma. Este cargo ativa jornadas de consumidor multi-etapas e multi-canais , aplicando regras de negócio, lógica de personalização e táticas de canal para entregar mensagens relevantes em grande escala.

Embora não seja responsável pelo desenvolvimento de backend ou automações técnicas , o profissional utiliza ferramentas nativas da plataforma (ex.: Journey Builder, Send Flows, Entry Criteria, Wait Steps, etc.) para executar campanhas de forma eficiente e precisa — sem necessidade de código . É necessário ter forte fluência nas capacidades de ativação self-service e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com leads de audiência, conteúdo e QA para garantir que todos os componentes estejam devidamente integrados.

Como especialista prático na configuração de jornadas e implantação de campanhas , este cargo permite que as marcas do setor entreguem comunicações consistentes, pontuais e de alto impacto via e-mail, push e outros canais próprios.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Direção de Marketing & Ativação

  • Traduzir estratégias de CRM e Loyalty em jornadas multi-etapas usando ferramentas self-service nativas da plataforma (ex.: funcionalidades drag & drop do SFMC).
  • Construir e lançar jornadas em E-mail, Push e SMS , incorporando lógica como wait steps, decision splits e regras de personalização baseadas nos objetivos da campanha.
  • Validar se todos os inputs necessários (ex.: audiências, templates, links, textos legais) estão completos e funcionais antes da ativação.
  • Monitorar jornadas ao vivo para detectar problemas de performance ou sinais operacionais (ex.: erros de audiência, falhas de lógica) e executar ajustes em tempo real quando necessário para garantir a integridade da execução .

Dados, Métricas & Otimização

  • Garantir a implementação correta da lógica de segmentação, critérios de entrada, tempos de espera e limites de frequência , alinhada à estratégia.
  • Marcar jornadas com IDs de campanha, metadados e parâmetros de rastreamento para suportar relatórios precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Analista de Performance & Insights para compartilhar observações da plataforma e validar os resultados das campanhas pós-lançamento.

Otimização de Processos de Campanha

  • Identificar lógicas repetitivas entre campanhas e propor estruturas modulares de jornada para aumentar a eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Manter documentação de melhores práticas de configuração de jornadas, checklists de QA de ativação e evolução dos padrões de execução.


Experiência e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de CRM, ativação de campanhas ou marketing de ciclo de vida, preferencialmente em organizações grandes e multi-mercado .
  • Experiência prática em lançamento e gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ESPs equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento funcional profundo de módulos da plataforma: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio .
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir estratégia em jornadas , utilizando wait steps, decision splits, filtros e lógica de conteúdo dinâmico .
  • Experiência em gerenciar calendários de campanhas complexos , com habilidade para lidar com várias ativações simultâneas em diferentes canais .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , identificando e resolvendo problemas de configuração, falhas ou anomalias de performance de forma independente.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes, orientação a processos e compromisso com a entrega impecável de campanhas .
  • Excelentes habilidades de colaboração para trabalhar com equipes de audiência, conteúdo, QA e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento em todas as camadas de execução.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integrations
description:
Blawk is building next-generation infrastructure to automate and analyze financial data at scale across the entertainment and creator economy.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Data Integrations) to help design and develop reliable automation pipelines for ingesting, mapping, and enriching large datasets from multiple external platforms. You’ll play a key role in connecting Blawk’s backend systems to external data sources, ensuring our data remains accurate, normalized, and scalable.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Founding Engineer to bring new data integrations online, enhance our normalization logic, and improve the reliability of ingestion across multiple environments.

This will start part-time, and advance to Full-time depending on performance. 


What the Candidate Will Do

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and data ingestion pipelines from external dashboards or portals.
  • Build data mappers that convert multiple schemas into a unified internal data model.
  • Implement error handling, logging, and monitoring for all ingestion jobs.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to refine the database structure and enrichment logic.
  • Document integration workflows to support scalability and future maintenance.
  • Work independently with clear milestones while communicating progress proactively.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering , preferably in backend or automation-heavy environments.
  • Strong coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, mainly inside NestJS and Node.js
  • Strong Experience integrating front end with backend applications such as Next.js 
  • Experience with web automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SQL-based data modeling and transformation pipelines.
  • Working proficiency in English (does not need to be fluent but able to communicate clearly with the team).
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver production-quality code with minimal oversight
  • Algorithm & Data Structures fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked list, DFS, BFS.
  • Experience in hands-on software development with thoughtfulness of scale, latency and distributed architecture.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or other modern cloud databases .
  • Background in ETL pipelines, data normalization, or automation frameworks .
  • Familiarity with browser automation, headless environments, or task scheduling tools & Queue managers. 
  • Passion for building reliable data systems that simplify complex workflows.


Bonus If

  • experience working in media, entertainment, or fintech data systems.
  • Experience with international stakeholders

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Position: Client Success Manager

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Time Zone: EST


Overview:


Our client is looking for a Client Success Manager to own relationships with agency clients, primarily chiropractic, dental, and medspa clinics. You’ll be their main point of contact, ensuring campaigns drive real results and clients stay informed, confident, and happy.


This role blends client communication, data-driven performance management, and coordination with internal teams to keep everything running smoothly, from onboarding to ongoing optimization.


What You’ll Do:


Daily Client Communication:

  • Be the main point of contact for each clinic client.
  • Communicate daily via calls, emails, and texts, keeping clients informed before they have to ask.
  • Provide clear updates on campaign performance, next steps, and upcoming improvements.
  • Build trust through responsiveness, proactivity, and transparency.


Client Onboarding:

  • Lead new clients through setup: ensuring tracking, GoHighLevel, and campaigns are properly configured.
  • Set expectations around timelines, deliverables, and what strong performance looks like.
  • Ensure a smooth and confident start to each new client relationship.


Monitor & Troubleshoot Campaigns:

  • Review ad and funnel performance daily, track metrics like CPL, leads generated, bookings, show rate, and conversion rate.
  • Identify drops or issues early (e.g., “show rate dropped 20% this week”) and diagnose potential causes.
  • Suggest actionable fixes: whether it’s a follow-up tweak, schedule adjustment, or new messaging.


Coordinate with Delivery Teams:

  • Communicate findings and improvement plans to the right team members (media buyers, appointment setters, etc.).
  • Ensure changes are executed effectively and followed through.
  • Bridge the gap between performance data and hands-on execution.


What You’ll Own:

  • Client performance metrics (leads, bookings, show %, close %).
  • Client satisfaction, retention, and renewal rates.
  • Proactive, fast communication and problem-solving.
  • Strategic understanding of marketing and sales processes, connecting data insights to business outcomes.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Previous experience in sales or lead generation.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to interpret data and turn insights into clear actions.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Comfort working with multiple clients and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A team player who collaborates well across departments.
